summary: Inventories can be INI or YAML; INI suits a few hosts, YAML becomes sensible as host counts grow and can give nodes unique names with ansible_host.
questions: Should I write my inventory in INI or YAML?
How do I give hosts friendly names in a YAML inventory?

answer_card.title: INI vs YAML inventory
answer_card.answer_md: Both work. INI is simple and readable for a small number of hosts. As your host count grows, YAML is a better fit, for example to give each node a unique name and set its address with `ansible_host`.
